[Thinking]
**Calculating Sundays**

I'm figuring out which day the 23rd of the month falls on, based on the information that the first and third Sundays are the 2nd and 16th. From this, I see that if the first Sunday is the 2nd, then the third Sunday being the 16th makes perfect sense since Sundays happen every 7 days. So, adding 7 days to the 16th gives me the 23rd, which is also a Sunday. It’s a simple calculation!
[/Thinking]

Sunday. Since Sundays are every 7 days, with Sundays on the 2nd and 16th, adding 7 to 16 gives 23, which is also a Sunday.
